comment: Authorization for agent actions. Decided from this file and the validated tool + arguments only; never from model text, justifications, or log contents. Keys are 'tool' or 'tool:target'.

restart_service:worker.why: low blast radius, reversible, a standard first fix

cleanup_spool.why: only *.tmp files, enforced by schema and action

scale_service:worker.why: more workers is reversible; beyond 3 costs capacity elsewhere

rotate_credential:payments.why: touches a secret and an external provider
